item.title: Decennial Census of the Population of Americans; Proposed Residence Criteria and Proposed Regulations for Demographic Questions
Optional Practical Training Fees
item.description: Federal Register · Comments due 2026-11-09 · S. workers. The following fees would apply for each F-1 nonimmigrant student to engage in OPT through a Student and Exchange Visitor Program-certified institution: $70,000 for initial OPT; and $30,000 for any subsequent OPT.

item.title: Eliminating the Discretionary 60-Day Grace Period
item.description: Federal Register · Comments due 2026-11-10 · 1(l)(2) to restore its previous and long- standing policy of not providing aliens in certain nonimmigrant classifications (and their dependents) with an up to 60-day grace period upon cessation of employment prior to the expiration of the alien's authorized period of stay.

item.title: Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility
item.description: Federal Register · Comments due 2026-11-13 · S. S. 1(c)(5), which generally provides that USCIS gives deference to a prior approval involving the same facts when adjudicating a request to extend a petition for an alien's employment or stay. S. workers.
